The [[Talortai/Legends|Talortai]] [[Urai Fen]] wielded two large '''blades''' that allowed him to cut through [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] like [[Grass/Legends|grass]]. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] could also bypass the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of vehicles and physically damage them.<ref name="Forces of Corruption Guide" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Urai Fen's blades first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption|''Forces of Corruption'']] expansion to the [[2006]] [[Petroglyph]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>
